title: The Rhythm of Your Heart
subtitle: A Novel
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: Soo-jin Park, a deaf Korean artist in London, sees music everywhere; she meets a jazz pianist and they discover love beyond sound.
style: Sensory, poetic third-person prose. Rich with the language of sound, silence, color, and music. Deeply empathetic.
characters: Soo-jin Park — deaf painter who sees music; a jazz pianist (the love interest).
notes: Early chapters — the gallery opening, the first meeting. Explore how they communicate and fall in love beyond sound. Handle deafness with dignity and authenticity.
